current: 登录后还可在其他同步的设备上使用这些书签。
rationale: en-US: "Sign in to grab bookmarks from other synced devices" — bookmarks are pulled from other devices to this one; the parallel signed-in string is correctly translated as 从其他同步的设备上接收书签.
suggest: 登录后即可获取其他同步设备上的书签。
summary: The translation reverses the direction of the sync: the source says signing in fetches bookmarks from other devices, not that bookmarks become usable on other devices.

current: 点按此处新建隐私浏览，浏览完毕后轻松删除历史记录和 Cookie 等数据。
rationale: en-US: "Tap here to start a fresh private session. Delete your history, cookies — everything." The deletion happens on tap, not "after you finish browsing" (浏览完毕后), which misstates the fire button's behavior.
suggest: 点按此处开始全新的隐私浏览会话，删除您的历史记录、Cookie，一切数据。
summary: The translation reverses the timing/meaning: the source says tapping deletes history and cookies now to start a fresh private session, not that data is deleted after browsing.

rationale: The developer comment says the field is where the user inputs their full name; Chinese uses 姓名 for a person's name, while 名称 refers to the name of an object or organization.
summary: "Name" in an address form refers to the person's full name, but the translation means "name/title" of a thing.

rationale: The comment explains a townland is a specific type of rural land division, not a town; 镇 means "town" and duplicates the Village or Township field.
summary: "Townland" (a rural land division) is rendered as 镇 (town), losing the specific meaning and colliding with other town-related fields.

current: %@ 将不会保存浏览期间的 Cookie 和历史记录
rationale: The en-US body ends with a period; the Chinese sentence has no terminating punctuation, unlike the other notification body strings in the same file.
suggest: %@ 将不会保存浏览期间的 Cookie 和历史记录。
summary: Missing sentence-ending period present in the source.

rationale: en-US "Reader View" is consistently 阅读视图 in Firefox zh-CN; 阅读模式 corresponds to "Reader Mode".
summary: "Reader View" is rendered as 阅读模式 (Reader Mode) instead of Firefox's standard 阅读视图.

rationale: The source term "Library" names the collection of Downloads, History, Passwords; Firefox zh-CN uses 资料库. 我的足迹 is a different, invented label.
summary: "Library" is translated as 我的足迹 ("my footprints"), which does not mean Library.

current: 若您使用的是企业网络，那么你们的支持团队可能了解更多信息。
rationale: The source uses "your" consistently; mixing 您 and 你们 in one sentence breaks the honorific register used throughout the file.
suggest: 若您使用的是企业网络，您的支持团队可能了解更多信息。
summary: Inconsistent register: the polite 您 switches to 你们 within the same sentence.

current: %@ 的管理员未正确配置此网站
rationale: The en-US source says "The owner of %@", not the administrator.
suggest: %@ 的所有者未正确配置此网站
summary: "owner" is rendered as 管理员 (administrator) instead of 所有者/拥有者.

rationale: Sibling strings use "1. " and "2. " with a space after the numeral; this one omits it.
summary: Missing space after the list number, inconsistent with the first and second labels.

rationale: iOS/Firefox zh-CN uses 深色/浅色 for Dark/Light themes; 深邃 ("profound") is not the established term.
summary: Theme name "Dark" translated as 深邃 instead of the standard 深色.

rationale: iOS/Firefox zh-CN uses 浅色 for the Light theme, paired with 深色 for Dark.
summary: Theme name "Light" translated as 明亮 instead of the standard 浅色.

current: 轻松握持就可唤起搜索。
rationale: The source means keeping search easily accessible (toolbar placement), not "easy gripping summons search"; 握持 (gripping) introduces meaning not in the source.
summary: "Keep searches within reach" is mistranslated as being about holding/gripping the phone.

current: 您发现 %1$@ 的途径及使用方式
rationale: The source only shares the fact that you use the app, not how you use it; the translation overstates the data shared.
suggest: 您发现 %1$@ 的途径以及您正在使用它这一事实
summary: "and that you use it" is mistranslated as "使用方式" (how you use it).

current: 纯粹带来更好的浏览体验。
rationale: The source has no notion of "purely/simply"; 纯粹 adds meaning not present in en-US.
suggest: 浏览体验就此更上一层楼。
summary: "Browsing just got better" rendered with a spurious "纯粹".

current: 自动阻止大公司窥探您的浏览活动
rationale: The en-US says "companies", not "big companies"; also "your clicks" is generalized to "浏览活动".
suggest: 自动阻止各公司窥探您的点击行为
summary: "companies" is rendered as "大公司" (big companies), adding a qualifier not in the source.

current: 通过内置隐私保护的浏览器打开链接
rationale: The en-US "Open your links with built-in privacy" does not mention a browser; the added noun changes the statement.
suggest: 打开链接，即享内置隐私保护
summary: Translation adds "的浏览器" (browser), which is not in the source.

current: 键入即可获取搜索建议、常用网站、书签、历史记录、搜索引擎，尽在一处。
rationale: Enumeration in Chinese should join the final item with 和/以及 rather than another 顿号; minor grammar issue.
suggest: 键入即可获取搜索建议、常用网站、书签、历史记录和搜索引擎，尽在一处。
summary: "bookmarks, history" is translated as "书签、历史记录" but "history" list item order/content drops nothing—actually "your top sites" fine; issue is "history" omitted? No—see rationale.

rationale: The source is a button that takes the user to a survey; the translation is just the noun "survey/questionnaire", losing the imperative action meaning.
summary: "Take Survey" (an action button) is rendered as the noun phrase "问卷调查" instead of a call to action.

rationale: The source is a status label meaning the feature is turned on/usable; the companion description string already uses "**可用**", so "提供" is both wrong in part of speech and inconsistent on the same screen.
summary: "Available" as a feature status is rendered as the verb "提供" instead of the adjective "可用".

rationale: The source lists two items, tips and features; the target omits "Features", which the accompanying description string also references.
summary: "Tips and Features" is translated as only "使用技巧", dropping "Features".

current: 前往设备设置中的“%@”开启通知
rationale: In en-US %@ is the app name and the user should open the device Settings to enable notifications for the app; the Chinese reads as if %@ were a section of device settings.
suggest: 前往设备的“设置”，开启 %@ 的通知
summary: Translation says go to the device setting item named %@ instead of going to device Settings to turn on notifications for %@.

current: 在隐私浏览中显示来自 Firefox 建议的结果
rationale: The source says "Show suggestions from Firefox Suggest in private sessions"; the translation says "results" rather than "suggestions", inconsistent with the parallel string Settings.Search.PrivateSession.Description.v125 which uses 建议.
suggest: 在隐私浏览中显示来自 Firefox 建议的建议
summary: "suggestions" is rendered as "结果" (results) instead of "建议".

current: 自动将页面翻译成您最熟悉的语言。

suggest: 自动将页面翻译成您的首选语言（列表中的第一种语言）。
summary: "top preferred language" is rendered as "最熟悉的语言" (most familiar language) instead of the top item in the preferred-languages list.

current: 翻译时将从这些语言中选择。
rationale: "Choose from these languages when translating" instructs the user that these languages will be available as choices; "将从这些语言中选择" states the system will pick one automatically.
suggest: 翻译时可从这些语言中选择。
summary: The footer reverses the agent: the app chooses from these languages when translating, but the translation implies a passive/unspecified selection process.

current: 您的账户中没有其他设备可供同步。

suggest: 您没有其他连接到此账户的设备可供同步。

rationale: The source is a button action title "Show Tabs"; adding 的 turns it into a noun phrase meaning "the displayed tabs", changing the meaning.

current: 关闭早于特定时间的标签页

summary: The ellipsis at the end of "Close tabs older than…" is dropped in the translation.

rationale: The source pair is Increase/Decrease Zoom Level; the decrease string uses 减小缩放比例, so the increase string should use 增大缩放比例. 放大…比例 is not a valid verb-object pairing.

rationale: The developer comment says this notifies the user that the tab is being closed; the Chinese lacks the in-progress aspect and reads as the action label "Close tab".

current: 两周内未查看的标签页将移至此处。

summary: Translation reverses the meaning: source says tabs not viewed for two weeks, target says tabs not viewed within two weeks (which reads as under two weeks).

current: 则可拦截更多跟踪器和弹窗

rationale: "Dark" as a theme setting is consistently "深色" in Firefox zh-CN; "深邃" means "profound/deep" and is not a theme name.

rationale: The button declines cancellation and resumes the download; "继续" alone is ambiguous next to "取消", the source is "Resume".

rationale: Developer comment states minutes should be abbreviated due to space constraints; the source is "min: %d". Chinese has no shorter form, but the label meaning "minutes to read" is lost — at minimum the reading context should be preserved compactly.

current: 我们的赞助商＆您的隐私

rationale: "Tab pickup" is the feature that lets you pick up a synced tab from another device; "接收标签页" reads as an action of receiving tabs rather than the section label.
